purpose: Structured labels for the item-generation QA and archive UI.

failure_codes.label: Incompatible material assembly
failure_codes.description: Individually plausible materials are combined in a mechanically implausible role or interface.
examples: woven plant-stem stripe spliced through a bronze helmet shell
rectangular stone or obsidian tiles woven into a flexible mitt or cuff
brittle mineral plate placed across an articulated joint

failure_codes.label: Missing join logic
failure_codes.description: Dissimilar parts touch without credible backing, overlap, holes, lacing, rivets, socketing, wrapping, or edge binding.

failure_codes.label: Material hierarchy inversion
failure_codes.description: A low-cost soft or plant material is used as exposed prestige decoration on a higher-value hard-material object instead of serving a functional supporting role.
examples: reed or straw crest filler framed as ornament on a bronze helmet
woven bast stripe decorating a brass shell
felt panel used as an exposed inlay on a metal gauntlet

failure_codes.label: Incoherent construction-family hybrid
failure_codes.description: The object combines two incompatible base families instead of committing to one mechanically legible construction system.
examples: comfortable quilted mitten with isolated bronze rectangles pasted onto the backhand
woven helmet with decorative brass bands or plates
metal helmet whose main dome is broken into ornamental reed panels

failure_codes.label: Missing structural counterpart
failure_codes.description: A normally paired or continuous component exists on only one visible side and the hidden counterpart is not mechanically implied.
examples: single cheek plate with no opposite hinge
one shoulder defense missing from an otherwise symmetric armor

failure_codes.label: Broken structural continuity
failure_codes.description: A rim, neck guard, band, backing, strap path, or load-bearing part stops or changes arbitrarily across the object.

failure_codes.label: Material density exceeds tier
failure_codes.description: The amount, rarity, precision, or coverage of reinforcement exceeds the assigned power tier.

failure_codes.label: Shingled cloak pattern
failure_codes.description: A cloak or mantle is incorrectly converted into rows of scale-like tabs, feathers, or lamellar imitation.

failure_codes.label: Archaeological decay finish
failure_codes.description: Usable equipment incorrectly copies an excavated artifact's corrosion, heavy patina, pitting, encrustation, burial staining, fading, cracks, or missing material.

failure_codes.label: Over-distressed surface
failure_codes.description: Wear and damage cover most of the item instead of remaining light, localized, and compatible with active service.
